what: Hoops Manager is an FBLA Computer Game & Simulation Programming entry. You run a high school basketball program for one season — recruiting, training, culture, and weekly choices — not individual plays.
rationale: The player manages the program rather than the plays, because the topic is about decisions on and off the court.
built: Python and pygame render a fixed 1280×720 window. Game logic lives in a pygame-free engine layer; screens handle input and drawing only. Balance numbers and all player-facing text live in JSON data files.
art: Every graphic is drawn in code from theme.py: court lines, panels, buttons, bars, scoreboard, and athlete cards. One bundled Inter font (SIL Open Font License) and three CC0-style sound effects (click, buzzer, chime).
accessibility: Preseason briefing on first launch; program dashboard with full How to Play guide; Display and Accessibility (high contrast, larger text, Inter font) via S on the dashboard. Body text is 24px minimum at default scale. Results always show triangles and +/− signs, not color alone. Keyboard, mouse, mute, and skippable scoreboard.
credits_sound: Short effects generated for this project (CC0-style, no attribution required).
testing: pytest unit tests including: seven factors sum to margin on 1,000 random games; action validation; lineup rules; overtime; seeded replay; forced endings; data validation.
journey_steps: Start: Hoops Manager tutorial, dashboard, and difficulty
Prepare: captain choice and weekly planning
improvements: Future work could add save games, animated court possessions, and expanded event art — cut from scope to ship a complete, explainable season in one sitting.
balance_note: Run tools/balance.py before the freeze and paste the printed table here for judges.
